name: OpenVibe.Meme

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the PostgreSQL database, Valkey, Network's JWKS and the OAuth client are what /api/ready checks)

drains: HTTP server closed and in-flight requests drained
JWKS refresher stopped, then the importer and re-verifier timers cleared
telemetry flushed and its retention timer stopped
PostgreSQL pool closed, then the Events subscriptions stopped

resumes.what: meme_outbox rows committed with an entry change survive a stop under their fixed evt_ ids; v1 has no relay yet, so unpublished rows wait for Search's document writer rather than being sent at boot
the importer makes its first pass 30 s after boot and the citation re-verifier 60 s after; each pass is whole and idempotent, so a stop mid-pass leaves the next one to finish

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates Meme's own tables (entries, citations, status events, votes, templates, captions, reports, outbox, account-data, telemetry); an earlier release reads none of them

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site and the API

notes: Port 5120, unit openvibe-meme.service, PostgreSQL database ov_meme. The Meme room: the open meme database, rebuilt with AI. The importer reads only public Chat, Live and Video APIs and proposes a candidate when a phrase recurs in at least two uses on two different days; the candidate is born hidden with a verbatim citation for every use and a staff person publishes it. A daily job re-verifies every citation: a 404/410 marks it gone, a 401/403 hidden, and an entry whose origin is gone is hidden. People vote once per ISO week for meme of the week, captions are plain text over a template, and every public entry is one search.index-document@1 queued in meme_outbox (a tombstone when it stops being public). OAuth client `meme`; answers account export and deletion (ADR-033) and subscribes to those Events topics.

site.name: Meme
site.what: Every entry in the open meme database cites the chat line or VOD second it came from, follows the later uses on a timeline, and keeps a status. Vote for meme of the week, caption a template, and report what needs fixing.
